q: Agent context files are common, and many of them stand still through hundreds of commits.
r: Include: measures currency and dangling references of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md context files in 452 popular repositories and proposes a governance discipline for agents, so group (b) with RQ4 relevance.

q: Instruction files have no per-change oracle, and no existing dataset separates instruction-file review from ordinary code review.
r: IC1: studies how PRs changing instruction files are reviewed and whether AI reviewers catch the concerns, which is code review of policy files and says nothing on the effect of context files on agent cost or quality.
